_meta.purpose: Which body system of the radar each PINNED polygenic model bears on. Read by engine/system_panels.py to print a system's common variation AS SCORES on its card (task 178) — beside the monogenic list, never inside the verdict and never inside the 0–100 score. The trait names are the keys of prs_models.json; the system keys are the keys of radar_domains.json, and a test fails when either side names something the other file does not hold.
_meta.who_writes_this: The project. Placing a trait on a system is a statement about which laboratory panel is the established screen for that trait — HbA1c for type 2 diabetes, the lipid panel for LDL cholesterol — not a claim about a person. A trait belongs to ONE system: a score printed on two cards would be one number read twice. Since 13.09.2026 the cardiovascular OUTCOMES — coronary artery disease, myocardial infarction, peripheral arterial disease, abdominal aortic aneurysm, and the six that had no domain before — stand on «Heart and vessels», the system whose panel (lipoprotein(a), apolipoproteins, fibrinogen, D-dimer) screens for them; the lipid system keeps the lipid MEASUREMENTS.

_meta.schema: systems: { <radar domain key>: { traits: [trait names — keys of prs_models.json], why_empty?: {en, ru} } } — a system with no pinned model bearing on it lists no traits and says why; a trait appears under one system at most; every pinned trait that appears under no system is named in _meta.why_partial with the reason. `fitness` is absent on purpose: it has no genetic half (radar_domains.json), so nothing may be placed on it.
